sources_added: Nour El Nil email to Nilecruz, undated (regular season rates, cabin counts, dimensions)

operator.name: Nour El Nil
operator.display_rule: Owner confirms permission to feature each boat and use its photos. Host photos on Nilecruz; never hotlink. Do not imply the boats can be booked on Nilecruz.

propulsion_support.text: Sails when the wind allows, with no engine on board. A towboat is used when needed.

operating_season.note: No sailings from June to August because of the heat.

itineraries.boarding_note: The operator collects guests from Luxor city hotels, usually between 09:00 and 09:30, for the drive to Esna. Airport pickup is not part of the standard transfer.

programme.title: Esna
programme.text: Board in Esna, then walk to the Temple of Khnum and through the town.

programme.title: El Kab and Edfu
programme.text: Visit the El Kab necropolis, then the Temple of Horus at Edfu.

programme.title: A day on the river
programme.text: Take an optional morning walk, then sail. There's time for a riverbank stop, a swim and a desert walk.

programme.title: Gebel Silsila
programme.text: Visit the Temple of Horemheb and the sandstone quarries, then sail on with a riverbank stop. Large cruise ships don't stop here.

programme.title: Kom Ombo
programme.text: Visit the temple and the Crocodile Museum.

programme.title: Disembarkation in Aswan
programme.text: Leave the boat in the morning near Aswan Bridge, where the authorities require dahabiyas to spend the final night.

included: Transfer from a Luxor hotel to Esna
Entry to the five sites visited
Official Egyptian guide, in your language if available
Transfer to a hotel on the Aswan mainland
not_included: Transfers to or from the airport

needs_confirmation.crew_and_guide_gratuities: The operator's email lists gratuities as not included, while its help pages say they are included. Do not show either way.

on_board.air_conditioning: 24-hour air conditioning, powered mainly by solar panels and batteries, with backup support
on_board.wifi: Wi-Fi uses mobile coverage along the route and works about 70% of the time. It suits messages, email and light browsing, not streaming or video calls.
on_board.laundry: No formal laundry service, but the crew can wash everyday clothing at no charge and air-dry it.
on_board.food: Mainly Egyptian cooking with ingredients bought along the river, often served on deck.
on_board.dietary: Vegetarian options are available. Gluten-free, dairy-free and other requests can be arranged in advance.

facilities_reported.note: Stated by the owner for all boats, but the operator's pages for El Nil and Najafa mention none of these. Do not display until checked with the operator.

suitability.children: Children are welcome. No minimum age is published.
suitability.mobility: Decks are connected by stairs and there's no elevator. Crew can help on board, but shore visits may involve uneven ground.
suitability.less_suited_to: Travellers who need an elevator or reliable internet.

charter.text: The whole boat can be privately chartered, with price depending on vessel and season.

operator_rate_model.occupancy: double, except Deluxe Suites (up to 4 guests)
operator_rate_model.note: Rates are regular season. High Season rates are not in this dataset. Do not convert to per night.

operator_terms.cancellation: More than 60 days out generally gives a rebooking credit; within 60 days, payments are forfeited.
operator_terms.single_occupancy: Generally 75% of the double-occupancy price in September and May, on eligible standard or Luxury Rooms, excluding High Season and panoramic or family categories.
operator_terms.early_departure: Leaving early does not reduce the price.
operator_terms.payment: Priced in euros and can be settled in USD. Visa, Mastercard and bank transfer are accepted. Individual payments above EUR 12,500 must be by bank transfer.

shared_sources.operator_email: Provided by owner; not a public URL

fleet_from_price_stated.note: Stated by the owner. The operator's lowest regular-season bookable rate is EUR 3,550 per double room, or EUR 1,775 per person, so do not display until reconciled.

fleet_defaults.route_note: The cruise does not visit Luxor or Aswan sights, because the operator avoids the busy ports. Book those tours before or after.
fleet_defaults.ends: Saturday or Sunday morning, near Aswan Bridge, depending on the start day

deluxe_suite.name: Deluxe Suite
deluxe_suite.feature: Sold as one unit. Set up as two bedrooms, or one bedroom with a private salon. No rollaway beds.
